sites.name: M/V HONDIUS
sites.desc: Ship anchored at Granadilla cargo port 04:00–06:00 local 10 May. WHO DG Tedros on-island to coordinate. Disembarkation by nationality in inflatable boats to isolated, cordoned quayside; sealed Spanish Army buses to airport only when repatriation aircraft confirmed runway-ready. 14 Spanish passengers first to transfer. All 147 aboard remain asymptomatic and PCR-negative as of 09 May. German woman's body still aboard; weather window closes Tuesday, ship to proceed to Netherlands post-disembarkation.

sites.name: USHUAIA / ARGENTINA ROUTE
sites.desc: Confirmed source investigation zone. WHO working hypothesis: index case (Dutch male, died 11 Apr) infected during activities in Argentina/Chile prior to boarding 01 Apr. Argentine Malbrán Institute dispatching team to Ushuaia; rodent trapping along index pair's 4-month travel route (27 Nov 2025–01 Apr 2026) active. Ushuaia landfill a specific investigation point. Argentine national tally: 101 hantavirus infections since Jun 2025.

sites.name: SAINT HELENA
sites.desc: 30 passengers disembarked 24 Apr including Dutch index male's body and Dutch widow (later died Johannesburg) and Swiss confirmed male. UKHSA contact-tracing 30 disembarkees plus 82 pax and 6 crew from 25 Apr Airlink St Helena–Johannesburg flight. Four Tristan da Cunha islanders also rode Hondius to St Helena per UK minister Doughty. Disembarkees from 12 countries departed before hantavirus confirmed 02 May.

sites.name: JOHANNESBURG
sites.desc: Case 2 (Dutch widow, 69, PCR+) died at Johannesburg hospital 26 Apr — confirmed Andes virus fatality. Case 3 (British guide Martin Anstee, 56, PCR+) treated at Johannesburg ICU; condition improved and transferred to Netherlands. On 08 May, a second British national in a South Africa health facility confirmed PCR-positive. NICD contact-traced 65+ contacts from 25 Apr Airlink flight. Asymptomatic South African woman (briefly in Barcelona) confirmed located and monitored.

sites.name: AMSTERDAM / NIJMEGEN
sites.desc: British Case 3 (Anstee, 56) transferred to Netherlands after condition improved. Dutch crew member (41, confirmed) treated at Radboud UMC Nijmegen. Netherlands lab PCR-confirmed German woman died of Andes virus. KLM flight attendant tested NEGATIVE 08 May — not secondary transmission. GGD Kennemerland escalated KL592 monitoring to ALL passengers on flight. RIVM/Dutch NIPH classified event as level A2 infectious disease. RIVM contact tracing ongoing.

sites.name: LONDON
sites.desc: UKHSA confirmed 2 British nationals PCR+ (one transferred to Netherlands, one confirmed 08 May in South Africa health facility) and one probable/suspected case on Tristan da Cunha (08 May). UK repatriation flight from Tenerife arranged; British nationals to isolate 45 days per UKHSA guidance. UKHSA also notes 4 Tristan da Cunha islanders rode Hondius to St Helena, expanding contact tracing scope.

sites.name: PARIS
sites.desc: Eight French nationals identified as close contacts of confirmed case on 25 Apr Airlink St Helena–Johannesburg flight — none were on the cruise. One reporting mild symptoms, isolated pending PCR. French health ministry coordinating diagnostics and quarantine. Repatriation flight from Tenerife confirmed for French nationals aboard ship.

sites.name: ZURICH
sites.desc: PCR-confirmed male passenger disembarked St Helena 24 Apr via South Africa and Qatar; symptoms onset 01 May, tested positive Andes virus 05 May at University Hospital Zurich. Wife (also on trip) asymptomatic and isolating. Swiss authorities conducting additional contact tracing for anyone who had contact with patient post-return.

sites.name: BERLIN / DÜSSELDORF
sites.desc: German woman died on board 02 May (fever/malaise onset 28 Apr, pneumonia). Netherlands postmortem PCR confirmed Andes virus. Asymptomatic 65-year-old German contact evacuated 06 May to Netherlands, then returned to Düsseldorf — subsequently tested NEGATIVE for hantavirus. RKI contact tracing active. Repatriation flight from Tenerife confirmed for German nationals aboard.

sites.name: ALICANTE
sites.desc: 32-year-old woman hospitalized in negative-pressure isolation with mild symptoms compatible with hantavirus; was on 25 Apr St Helena–Johannesburg flight seated two rows behind deceased Dutch woman. PCR results pending as of 10 May. Health Secretary Padilla expressed confidence result will be negative, citing KLM flight attendant precedent. If negative, patient to transfer to Gómez Ulla military hospital for quarantine.

sites.name: TENERIFE
sites.desc: Hondius anchored Granadilla cargo port 04:00–06:00 local 10 May. WHO DG Tedros personally on island. Passengers evacuated by nationality via inflatable boats to cordoned quayside; sealed Spanish Army buses to airport. EU Civil Protection Mechanism provided 2 aircraft for EU nations lacking own lift. All repatriation flights to be runway-ready before respective nationals disembark. Weather window closes Tuesday.

sites.name: MADRID
sites.desc: Gómez Ulla Military Hospital activated to receive 14 Spanish Hondius passengers. Protocol covers all aboard 01 Apr–10 May or in close contact with confirmed case; PCR on arrival + Day 7; twice-daily temperature checks; single rooms, no visitors. Biosecurity equivalent to Ebola/COVID-19 protocols. Alicante patient to transfer here if PCR-negative. Spain's Interior Minister Grande-Marlaska personally overseeing disembarkation logistics.

sites.name: BARCELONA
sites.desc: Two Barcelona contacts monitored: (1) South African woman (asymptomatic flight contact of Dutch deceased) spent ~1 week here before returning to South Africa — confirmed asymptomatic. (2) Barcelona-resident woman identified 09 May as flight contact after initially escaping detection due to mid-flight seat change; asymptomatic, placed under official monitoring per Spanish Health Ministry.

sites.name: TRISTAN DA CUNHA
sites.desc: UKHSA confirmed probable case 08 May: British male islander who was aboard Hondius during 13–15 Apr Tristan da Cunha stop; symptoms onset 28 Apr, currently stable in isolation on island. UK Minister for Overseas Territories Stephen Doughty wrote to island administration confirming patient is 'an islander' and spouse is isolating. Four additional islanders had ridden Hondius to St Helena, expanding contact tracing scope.

sites.name: SINGAPORE
sites.desc: CLEARED 09 May: Both male residents (aged 67 and 65) tested NEGATIVE for hantavirus including Andes virus via multiple PCR samples — Singapore CDA confirmed. Both had disembarked Hondius at St Helena and traveled on 25 Apr Airlink St Helena–Johannesburg flight. Monitoring continues as precaution through full incubation window.

sites.name: ONTARIO
sites.desc: Two Ontario residents self-isolating — Hondius passengers who returned home early, asymptomatic. Four Canadians total remain aboard vessel awaiting Tenerife evacuation. PHAC coordinating monitoring per 07 May government statement.

sites.name: QUEBEC
sites.desc: One Quebec resident self-isolating — not a Hondius passenger but shared homebound flight with two Canadian Hondius disembarkees. Asymptomatic; PHAC monitoring active.

sites.name: ARIZONA
sites.desc: ADHS monitoring one returning passenger under 42-day observation. Asymptomatic as of 09 May. CDC notified ADHS 05 May; public risk assessed as very low. Part of domestic US monitoring cohort across 6 states; all 17 Americans still aboard as of 09 May test negative and asymptomatic per CDC.

sites.name: CALIFORNIA
sites.desc: CDPH monitoring one returned Hondius traveler via daily temperature checks and symptom assessment. A second California resident remains aboard ship and will transit Tenerife to Nebraska NQU via CDC-escorted State Dept biocontainment charter. No California residents reported ill or infected as of 09 May.

sites.name: GEORGIA
sites.desc: Georgia DPH monitoring two residents who returned from Hondius. Both in good health with no signs of infection as of 09 May. Following CDC recommendations. Part of domestic US monitoring cohort across 6 states.

sites.name: TEXAS
sites.desc: Texas DSHS monitoring two returning Hondius passengers. Both asymptomatic. Part of domestic US monitoring cohort across 6 states; none of the monitored US residents exhibiting signs of illness as of 09 May.

sites.name: VIRGINIA
sites.desc: VDH monitoring one returning Hondius passenger. Asymptomatic. CDC classified response as Level-3 (lowest emergency activation tier); Emergency Operations Center activated. Six states — AZ, CA, GA, TX, VA, NJ — monitoring at least 9 early-disembarkees or contacts per CDC/CNN 09 May reporting.

sites.name: NEW JERSEY
sites.desc: NJ health authorities monitoring two individuals potentially exposed to a Hondius passenger post-disembarkation. Neither symptomatic as of 09 May. Part of broader US monitoring cohort per CNN/CDC reporting.

sites.name: NEBRASKA
sites.desc: Nebraska Medicine / UNMC National Quarantine Unit (NQU) fully staffed and activated. CDC team pre-deployed to Offutt AFB, Bellevue. 17 American Hondius passengers to arrive via CDC-escorted State Dept biocontainment charter from Tenerife — all 17 PCR-negative and asymptomatic as of 09 May per CDC. Dr. Wadman (NQU medical director) and Dr. Ash (CEO Nebraska Medicine) confirmed full readiness.

sites.name: UTAH
sites.desc: Utah DHHS confirmed at least one Utah resident is among the 17 Americans still aboard MV Hondius. Person is asymptomatic and will disembark Tenerife, then travel with federal escort to Nebraska NQU for quarantine. No Utah residents monitored at home as of 09 May.

sites.name: MANILA
sites.desc: 38 Filipino crew members aboard Hondius; Philippines DOH confirmed none currently ill as of 09 May. In close coordination with vessel operator and international authorities. Monitoring continues pending Tenerife disembarkation and subsequent repatriation.

sites.name: DUBLIN
sites.desc: Two Irish nationals confirmed aboard Hondius per ECDC briefing (Ireland among nine EU/EEA nationalities on board). Repatriation flight from Tenerife confirmed via EU Civil Protection Mechanism aircraft. Irish Dept of Health coordinating with ECDC and WHO; no symptomatic cases reported.

sites.name: PRAIA
sites.desc: Hondius anchored off Praia 03–06 May; departed 19:15 local 06 May for Tenerife. Three medevac patients evacuated here 06 May — two flew to Amsterdam (received by specialist teams at Schiphol), third plane made unscheduled refueling stop at Gran Canaria after Morocco refused permission and a medical equipment malfunction caused delays. Cape Verde assessed unable to handle full passenger evacuation.

sites.name: COPENHAGEN
sites.desc: Danish Patient Safety Authority confirmed one Danish national was aboard MV Hondius. Person returned to Denmark end of April, is self-isolating, displayed no symptoms, and was not in close contact with any confirmed cases. Monitoring active per national protocol.

sites.name: BRUSSELS
sites.desc: Belgian nationals confirmed aboard Hondius per ECDC briefing (Belgium among nine EU/EEA nationalities). Repatriation from Tenerife via EU Civil Protection Mechanism aircraft confirmed. Belgian federal health authorities coordinating with ECDC. No symptomatic cases reported.

sites.name: WELLINGTON
sites.desc: New Zealand confirmed among 12+ countries monitoring nationals who had disembarked MV Hondius per WHO/CBS News 08 May. NZ Ministry of Health coordinating contact tracing; no symptomatic cases reported.

sites.name: STOCKHOLM
sites.desc: Sweden confirmed among 12+ countries monitoring nationals who had disembarked MV Hondius. Swedish Public Health Agency (Folkhälsomyndigheten) coordinating; no symptomatic cases reported.

sites.name: ANKARA
sites.desc: Turkey confirmed among 12+ countries monitoring nationals who had disembarked MV Hondius. Turkish Ministry of Health coordinating; no symptomatic cases reported.

sites.name: BASSETERRE
sites.desc: Saint Kitts and Nevis confirmed among 12+ countries monitoring nationals who had disembarked MV Hondius. Local health authorities monitoring; no symptomatic cases reported.

sites.name: ATHENS
sites.desc: Greek nationals confirmed aboard Hondius per ECDC briefing (Greece among nine EU/EEA nationalities on board). Greek Ministry of Health coordinating with ECDC; no symptomatic cases reported. Monitoring of returning nationals underway.

sites.name: WARSAW
sites.desc: Polish nationals confirmed aboard Hondius per ECDC briefing (Poland among nine EU/EEA nationalities on board). Polish Chief Sanitary Inspectorate coordinating with ECDC; no symptomatic cases reported.

sites.name: LISBON
sites.desc: Portuguese nationals confirmed aboard Hondius per ECDC briefing (Portugal among nine EU/EEA nationalities on board). DGS Portugal coordinating with ECDC; no symptomatic cases reported.
